name: Terrain gallery (p303)
description: The toolkit's terrain texture library, one isolated 12 × 12 m block per texture set (rows from the back: sand and mud, rocks and cliffs, snow and ice, grass and concrete), each drawn by the baseline material textureSetSurface (world tiling, no anti-tiling or splat) in the set's default packing. Each block is a generated terrain with gentle 0.4 m noise and its back edge raised into a 35° ramp; the cliff blocks have a 6 m wall (tiled at its UVs in metres). The DAY_NIGHT sky stands still at 10:00 and lights the scene.
